A '''purple reptilian, snake-like creature''' was hiding inside a [[Unidentified green reptilian Endorian creature|larger reptile]], which was hanging from the ceiling in [[Logray's hut]] in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. It angrily stuck its head out of the larger beast’s mouth and snarled at an intruding [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] who peeked inside. It had large fangs, yellow eyes, and spikes on its head and upper neck.<ref name="1-02">{{Ewoks|The Haunted Village}}</ref>
